scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @kydao/server" "npm run dev -w @kydao/web"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kydao/engine && npm run typecheck -w @kydao/server && npm run typecheck -w @kydao/web
